en: O God, I ask pardon from Thee for

ar: مِنْ مَـظْلُوم ظُلِمَ بِحَضْرَتِي فَلَمْ أَنْصُرْهُ،
en: the person wronged in my presence whom I did not help,

ar: وَمِنْ مَعْرُوف أُسْدِيَ إلَيَّ فَلَمْ أَشْكُرْهُ،
en: the favour conferred upon me for which I returned no thanks,

ar: وَمِنْ مُسِيء أعْتَذَرَ إلَيَّ فَلَمْ أَعْذِرْهُ،
en: the evildoer who asked pardon from me and whom I did not pardon,

ar: وَمِنْ ذِيْ فَاقَة سَأَلَنِي فَلَمْ اُوثِرْهُ،
en: the needy person who asked from me and whom I preferred not over myself,

ar: وَمِنْ حَقِّ ذي حَقٍّ لَزِمَنِي لِمُؤْمِن فَلَمْ أوَفِّـرْهُ،
en: the right of a believer who possesses a right incumbent upon me which I did not fulfil,

ar: وَمِنْ عَيْبِ مُؤْمِن ظَهَر لِي فَلَمْ أَسْتُرْهُ،
en: the fault of a believer which became evident to me and which I did not conceal,

ar: وَمِنْ كُلِّ إثْم عَرَضَ لِيْ فَلَمْ أَهْجُرْهُ.
en: and every sin which presented itself to me and which I failed to avoid.
I ask pardon, my God, for all of these
and their likes, with an asking of pardon in remorse

ar: يَكُونُ وَاعِظاً لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنْ أَشْبَاهِهِنَّ.
en: which may act as an admonisher against similar things ahead of me.
So bless Muhammad and his Household

ar: وَاجْعَلْ نَدَامَتِي عَلَى مَا وَقَعْتُ فِيهِ مِنَ الـزَّلاّتِ
en: and make my remorse for the slips into which I have fallen

ar: وَعَزْمِي عَلَى تَـرْكِ مَا يَعْـرِضُ لِيْ مِنَ السَّيِّئـاتِ
en: and my determination to refrain from the evil deeds which present themselves to me
a repentance which will make Thy love for me obligatory,
O lover of those who repent!
